prompt_text: A wide cinematic shot of storm clouds swirling above the towering, snow-covered peaks of Mount Kailash, dramatic lighting casting sharp shadows across the icy ridges. The camera angle is aerial, descending slowly toward the majestic Himalayan mountains. Dark clouds churn ominously in the sky, lit by flashes of distant lightning. Fierce winds sweep through the scene, bending the snow-laden trees and lifting snow flurries into the air. The mood is tense and divine, as if nature is holding its breath before a revelation. The environment dominates the frame—no characters, just the raw mythic power of the sacred landscape.

A cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva seated in deep stillness atop the twilight-lit summit of Mount Kailash. His tall, lean muscular form glows faintly with a subtle, divine light. Ashen skin contrasts against the darkening sky, and his dark brown matted locks flow gently in the wind. The crescent moon rests in his hair, and the sacred river Ganga trickles down from his locks like threads of light. Around his neck, serpents coil peacefully. A damaru drum rests beside him. His third eye, closed for now, is etched on his forehead. The lighting is dramatic, casting long shadows and illuminating his glowing aura. The mood is serene yet powerful, evoking the eternal calm before cosmic movement. Snow drifts silently around him as the camera slowly draws closer to this mythic figure of stillness and divine presence.

Cinematic close-up of Shiva standing atop a windy mountain peak, his tall, lean muscular form anchored in divine stillness. His dark brown matted locks unravel in the gusting wind, revealing a glowing crescent moon delicately nestled within his hair and the sacred Ganga flowing down in shimmering streams of light. His ashen skin glows softly against the stormy sky, and serpents rest calmly around his neck. A damaru drum lies beside him, half-buried in snow. His third eye is etched but closed, radiating latent energy. Dramatic lighting casts divine highlights on his face and hair, with particles of snow and strands of light swirling around him. Low-angle shot emphasizes his mythic presence against the roaring sky. The mood is reverent and charged, capturing the quiet power of a god in motion.

Cinematic wide-angle shot of a vast, star-streaked night sky above Mount Kailash, rippling with cosmic patterns and glowing constellations. The atmosphere is alive with celestial energy, as if the universe itself is breathing. Stars shimmer and pulse in synchronized rhythm, responding to an unseen divine presence. Nebulae swirl in slow motion, casting ethereal hues of violet, blue, and gold across the sky. The mountain peak is silhouetted below, grounding the divine spectacle. Dramatic lighting from the stars bathes the scene in shifting glows. The camera slowly pans across the sky, capturing the grandeur and mystery. The mood is awe-inspiring and sacred, evoking the presence of something beyond mortal comprehension. No characters in focus—pure environmental majesty.

Cinematic medium-wide shot of a snow-dusted mountain slope with sparse pine trees and rocks. In the distance, a group of large adult tigers prowls silently through the snow, their orange fur with bold black stripes contrasting against the white terrain. Their muscular forms move with grace and purpose, heads lowered in calm reverence as they observe the divine presence from afar. The wind carries faint echoes of a cosmic hum. Dramatic side lighting casts elongated shadows, enhancing their powerful yet subdued presence. Camera angle is low, emphasizing the tigers' majestic and mythic quality while maintaining the scale of the mountain environment. The mood is tense yet respectful, capturing nature’s acknowledgment of something greater.

Cinematic close-up of Shiva’s upper body, focusing on the serpents loosely coiled around his neck. The slender, flexible serpents have dark, mottled skin and rest without tension, gently shifting with the rhythm of his breath. Their scales glisten under the dramatic lighting, which highlights the serene texture of Shiva’s ashen skin and the divine aura emanating from his form. The camera angle is low, enhancing the mythical perspective of the serpents as calm guardians rather than threats. Snowflakes drift in the background as wind stirs Shiva’s hair slightly. The mood is quiet and reverent, capturing the stillness and sacred balance between deity and nature.

Cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva seated in deep meditation, his tall, lean muscular body glowing faintly with an ethereal aura. As he breathes deeply, the air around him pulses, sending visible ripples across the cosmos behind him. Stars scatter and shimmer in rhythmic waves, as if responding to his breath. His ashen skin radiates calm power, dark brown matted locks sway gently, revealing the crescent moon and flowing Ganga. Serpents rest at his throat, unmoving in the divine stillness. The background blends a surreal celestial landscape with waves of light and vibration expanding outward. Dramatic cosmic lighting illuminates his form, enhancing the sacred, mythic atmosphere. The mood is intense and reverent, capturing the moment where divine breath reshapes reality.

Cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva as his eyes open slowly, revealing a blazing third eye at the center of his forehead that erupts like a sun. His lean, muscular form radiates divine energy, ashen skin glowing with celestial power. His dark brown matted locks are slightly lifted by cosmic wind, framing the crescent moon and the flowing Ganga. The background is a void-like darkness, suddenly pierced by the radiant flash from his third eye, casting shockwaves of light through the surrounding space. Serpents around his neck remain still, unfazed by the awakening power. Dramatic lighting emphasizes the explosion of divine energy, with golden and white beams tearing across the frame. The mood is overwhelmingly powerful and tense, as the very fabric of space and time seems to bend around him.

Cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva standing at the center of a collapsing cosmic realm, his tall, lean muscular figure surrounded by a swirling golden aura. His ashen skin glows against the backdrop of time-lapse visuals—stars reversing course, galaxies folding inward, and ancient moments dissolving into pure light. His dark brown matted locks flow gently, the crescent moon and Ganga glowing within them. Serpents rest serenely around his neck as the universe slows. The third eye on his forehead remains open, softly radiant. Dramatic lighting from all directions blends silence with golden shimmer, casting long shadows and celestial highlights across Shiva’s divine form. The mood is reverent and timeless, capturing the sacred moment where time dissolves into pure being.

Cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva standing in a dim, glowing void between worlds, surrounded by swirling cosmic mist and faint starlight. His tall, lean muscular figure is radiant with an ashen glow, matted dark brown locks cascading around his shoulders, with the crescent moon and flowing Ganga illuminated in the strands. Serpents rest still and coiled around his neck. His eyes are focused, intense. Shiva lifts his damaru with one hand, the small drum glowing with divine energy. As he strikes it, a shockwave of golden sound ripples through the space, warping light and echoing like thunder across dimensions. Dramatic lighting captures the split-second burst of cosmic rhythm, highlighting the power and grace of this mythic moment. The mood is tense, sacred, and awakening—the birth of movement in a still universe.

Cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva mid-dance, his lean muscular form in a dynamic pose, surrounded by spiraling flames and swirling galaxies. His matted dark brown locks whip through the air, adorned with the crescent moon and streaming Ganga. His ashen skin glows with divine intensity, the third eye on his forehead radiating cosmic fire. Serpents remain coiled around his neck, moving subtly with his rhythm. Each step sends shockwaves through the cosmos, reshaping stars and space itself. The background is a breathtaking fusion of fire and celestial bodies, twisting in sync with his movements. Dramatic lighting emphasizes the power and fluidity of his dance, casting glowing reflections across his figure and the cosmic storm. The mood is awe-inspiring and fierce, capturing the mythic moment of destruction and rebirth through divine motion.

Cinematic low-angle shot of Shiva standing in perfect stillness amidst a maelstrom of exploding galaxies and swirling cosmic chaos. His tall, lean muscular form glows with an ashen hue, unmoved and unshaken. Dark brown matted locks float gently in the cosmic wind, framing the crescent moon and the flowing Ganga. The serpents around his neck are motionless, calm within the storm. His third eye blazes silently, casting a steady beam of divine light through the turbulence. The background is filled with radiant bursts of stars and nebulae spiraling outward, yet Shiva remains the still eye at the center of eternity. Dramatic lighting contrasts the violent motion with the unwavering serenity of his presence. The mood is tense, eternal, and transcendent—capturing the paradox of absolute stillness within infinite movement.
